title: Disable CPU Core Parking
name: disable-core-parking
modal: This keeps all CPU cores awake. Idle power usage will be higher.
description: Keeps all CPU cores unparked to kill stutters from cores waking up mid-game
deepDescription:
Parked CPU cores take time to wake, causing frame spikes when a game suddenly needs them. This forces 100% of cores to stay unparked:

- Minimum unparked cores → 100%

Revert restores the 10% default. Idle power usage is higher.
